reconcile.note: Fausset and his co-commentators read James's 'works' as visible proof of the very faith Hebrews already credits to Rahab, not a rival ground of salvation.

sides.snippet: By faith, Rahab the prostitute, didn't perish with those who were disobedient
sides.verseText: By faith, Rahab the prostitute, didn't perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

sides.snippet: wasn't Rahab the prostitute also justified by works, in that she received the messengers
sides.verseText: In like manner wasn't Rahab the prostitute also justified by works, in that she received the messengers, and sent them out another way?
